product.title: Boulder to Eldorado Canyon E-Bike Tour with Ice Cream Stop

description.text: Explore the stunning landscapes of Boulder and Eldorado Canyon on a thrilling half-day e-bike tour. This 29-mile journey takes you along peaceful bike paths and scenic roads, showcasing the majestic Flatirons and the natural beauty that Colorado is famous for. Stops include Harlow Platts Community Park, Eldorado Canyon State Park, The Boulder Dushanbe Teahouse, Boulder Canyon Scenic Drive, Chautauqua Park. Enjoy a refreshing artisanal ice cream break at the Dushanbe Teahouse, and learn about local history at the Eldorado Canyon park visitor center. Ideal for visitors basing in Boulder who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
